schema.name: CloudflareSecurityEvents_CL
schema.description: Cloudflare security (firewall) events ingested from the Cloudflare GraphQL Analytics API (firewallEventsAdaptive dataset, account scope). Captures requests acted on by Cloudflare security products including the WAF managed and custom rulesets, rate limiting, L7 DDoS mitigation, IP reputation and bot mitigations.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: The timestamp of the firewall event, derived from the Cloudflare 'datetime' field (when the request was evaluated).

columns.name: Action
columns.description: The action the firewall rule took when it matched the request (for example, 'block', 'challenge', 'allow', 'log', 'skip', 'managed_challenge', 'jschallenge').

columns.name: Source
columns.description: The Cloudflare security product/source that produced the event (for example, 'firewallManaged', 'firewallCustom', 'ratelimit', 'l7ddos', 'bic', 'hot', 'securityLevel', 'ipReputation', 'sanitycheck').

columns.name: Kind
columns.description: The kind of firewall event. Currently always 'firewall'.

columns.name: Description
columns.description: A human-readable description of the rule or managed rule signature that matched (for example, the WAF managed rule name).

columns.name: Ref
columns.description: The user-defined reference (ref) tag of the matched rule, when configured.

columns.name: RuleId
columns.description: The identifier of the rule that matched the request.

columns.name: RulesetId
columns.description: The identifier of the ruleset that contains the matched rule.

columns.name: MatchIndex
columns.description: The index of the rule match within the request evaluation order.

columns.name: RayName
columns.description: The Cloudflare Ray ID associated with the request that generated the event.

columns.name: OriginatorRayName
columns.description: The Ray ID of the originating request when the event was generated by a related/sub request ('00' when not applicable).

columns.name: SampleInterval
columns.description: The sampling interval for the event. A value of 1 means the event was not sampled; values greater than 1 indicate each stored event represents that many requests.

columns.name: ClientIP
columns.description: The IP address of the client that made the request.

columns.name: ClientIPClass
columns.description: Cloudflare's classification of the client IP (for example, 'clean', 'badHost', 'searchEngine', 'allowlist', 'monitoringService', 'noRecord', 'unknown').

columns.name: ClientAsn
columns.description: The Autonomous System Number (ASN) of the client that made the request.

columns.name: ClientASNDescription
columns.description: The description/name of the client's Autonomous System (for example, 'Microsoft Corporation').

columns.name: ClientCountryName
columns.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the client, derived from the client IP.

columns.name: ClientRequestHTTPHost
columns.description: The HTTP host header of the request.

columns.name: ClientRequestHTTPMethodName
columns.description: The HTTP method of the request (for example, 'GET', 'POST').

columns.name: ClientRequestHTTPProtocol
columns.description: The HTTP protocol version of the request (for example, 'HTTP/1.1', 'HTTP/2').

columns.name: ClientRequestPath
columns.description: The URI path of the request.

columns.name: ClientRequestQuery
columns.description: The URI query string of the request.

columns.name: ClientRequestScheme
columns.description: The URI scheme of the request (for example, 'http', 'https').

columns.name: ClientRefererHost
columns.description: The host portion of the HTTP Referer header.

columns.name: ClientRefererPath
columns.description: The path portion of the HTTP Referer header.

columns.name: ClientRefererQuery
columns.description: The query string portion of the HTTP Referer header.

columns.name: ClientRefererScheme
columns.description: The scheme portion of the HTTP Referer header.

columns.name: UserAgent
columns.description: The User-Agent header string of the client request.

columns.name: EdgeColoName
columns.description: The IATA airport code of the Cloudflare data center (colo) that handled the request (for example, 'IAD', 'ORD').

columns.name: EdgeResponseStatus
columns.description: The HTTP status code Cloudflare's edge returned to the client.

columns.name: OriginResponseStatus
columns.description: The HTTP status code the origin server returned, or 0 when the edge responded without contacting the origin.

columns.name: HttpApplicationVersion
columns.description: The internal HTTP application version associated with the request.

columns.name: ZoneTag
columns.description: The Cloudflare zone identifier (zone tag) the event belongs to. Useful for distinguishing zones in an account-wide query.

columns.name: ZoneVersion
columns.description: The version of the zone configuration in effect when the event was generated.
